title: Tenant schema and search_path state causes GH-359-class failures
notes: Cluster C from the final integration run: TC-TNT-01-01, TC-TNT-01-03, TC-TNT-02-02, TC-TNT-03-01, TC-TNT-03-03, TC-TNT-03-05, and TC-DB-03-01 fail because a tenant table/schema is absent or a connection remains on search_path='public'. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 6384-6503, 8713-8728, and 38774-38872. Follow-on/extension of GitHub #359.
root_cause: TBD. Initial hypothesis: tenant provisioning and connection checkout do not establish a deterministic tenant schema/search_path state for all integration paths, compounded by shared schema state previously tracked in GitHub #359.
candidate_resolution: Extend the GitHub #359 investigation to reconcile shadow/missing tenant schemas, enforce explicit tenant context before checkout, and add assertions that every checked-out connection resolves the intended schema before unqualified business-table queries.
